input.free_text_description: The system operates in the authentication, microservices infrastructure domain. It serves User as its primary actors. The main business capabilities include account, auth server, discovery server.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to manage my account settings, so that my preferences and personal data stay under my control.
As a User, I want to register and authenticate, so that I can securely access my account and protected resources.
As a User, I want to manage application configuration centrally, so that all services pick up the latest settings without redeployment.
As a User, I want to manage auth server operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
As a User, I want to interact with discovery server functionality, so that the system fulfills my needs.
